name: Elizabeth Warren
committees: Senate Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs
stance: Leading Senate critic demanding mandatory, independent, enforceable safety screening of frontier AI models, and transparency over industry-captured voluntary oversight.

statements.text: With Sen. Blumenthal, pressed the White House over AI-industry influence that reportedly softened a draft requiring frontier AI to undergo mandatory safety screening before release into a voluntary, industry-designed process.
the Trump Administration is accommodating the interests of Big Tech CEOs rather than addressing the safety and security risks posed by increasingly sophisticated AI systems

the American people deserve strong guardrails set by their democratically elected officials, not a toothless framework shaped in secret by a handful of executives at self-interested trillion-dollar companies

review.note: added October 2026 from warren.senate.gov primary sources; quotes verified verbatim
